title: terraform: private GPU node pools, IAM roles, networking and state layout refactor
author: Priya Sharma
description: Motivation: standardize and simplify Terraform modules used for Private deployments with GPUs and to prepare a safer state layout for future multi-region/private installs. This PR splits the existing monolithic private module into focused modules (gpu_node_pool, iam_roles, networking, state) and introduces a migration path for existing state files. Work included: 1) new modules/gpu_node_pool with size/taints/gpu-type/accelerator profiles and node pool autoscaling hooks; 2) iam_roles module that centralizes service account roles and platform policies with predictable naming and optional IAM binding batching; 3) networking module tweaks to support secondary ranges for pod IPs and consistent subnet naming across regions; 4) state module and README that document and implement the recommended remote state layout (per-environment buckets + locking + key prefixes) and a migration script to move legacy state without downtime; 5) examples/private/deploy.tf updated and e2e fixtures for CI; 6) backwards-compatible variables and deprecation warnings for removed outputs. Migration and safety: added a state-migration script (scripts/tf-state-migrate.sh) that runs a dry-run plan and includes explicit checklists; the plan ensures node pool replacements are done with rolling updates and a canary node pool for zero-downtime rollouts. Testing: validated terraform fmt/validate, ran terraform plan against staging account, executed e2e smoke tests on a non-prod VPC, and tested IAM policies in an isolated project. Checklist: [x] module split and interfaces documented; [x] migration script and docs; [x] CI plan and e2e smoke; [x] reviewer feedback addressed; [x] release notes drafted. Related: Linear ENG-8421 for private installer upgrades, INF-1280 for state layout. This description is a single continuous string per PR content rules.
